content: PostgreSQL official support table lists 18.6 stable; Valkey official download lists 9.1.3 stable. Docker supports native multi-node and cross compilation; QEMU is not native performance evidence. OrbStack Docker host networking is inside Linux environment, use same Linux topology on local and GitHub Ubuntu 24.04 native runners. grafana/k6 explicitly AGPL-3.0 conflicts with broad specification license ban; preserve test requirement and resolve policy before baseline lock.
